notes: The first Limpid for Linux: the same Limpid as on Windows, straight to your DAC, with Streaming through Lyrion (Limpid installs Lyrion for you), the Queue, Favorites, playlists and the remotes.
For x64 and Arm PCs. Unpack it and run install.sh: it installs for you alone, no administrator needed. Settings › Check for Updates brings the next versions.
